title: Raf İzi: Home Library
shortDescription: Snap your shelves, find any book in seconds. Track reading, loans & quotes.
fullDescription:
Raf İzi maps your home library so you always know where every book is.

Snap a photo of a shelf and AI reads the spines, adding each book with its author and publisher – and remembers which shelf it's on and its position from the left. Prefer one at a time? Scan the barcode on the back cover.

Type a title and its spot lights up on your bookcase map. Drag books to rearrange your shelves, or let Raf İzi suggest an order by author, category, publisher or colour.

• Shelf photo and barcode scanning
• Find any book on your shelf map instantly
• "Do I own it?" – scan a barcode at the bookshop before you buy twice
• Reading list with page progress, ratings, notes and yearly stats
• Quote scanner: photograph an underlined passage and save it with its page number
• Lending tracker with reminders and a friendly WhatsApp nudge
• Family library: share one library with your household; reading and lending stay personal
• Covers, ISBN, page count and year filled in from the web
• Export to Excel, back up, and import from Goodreads or a spreadsheet
• Sign in with Google and use it on your phone and on the web (rafizi.web.app)

No ads. Your library is private to your account.
